title: Code and derived data for: A connectome-calibrated test of a splice-isoform chemoaffinity code in mouse visual cortex
description: Pipeline (remote unindexed-BAM junction extraction, MICrONS geometric null model, isoform-gated adhesion compatibility, null-calibrated tests) and derived per-cell junction tables for 1,543 SMART-seq v4 and 1,800 Patch-seq neurons.
